questions.question: How did Saul die on Mount Gilboa?
options: He was captured alive and led away
He fell in single combat with a mighty champion
He died of a sudden sickness in his tent
He fell on his own sword after being wounded
questions.answer: He fell on his own sword after being wounded

questions.question: What happened to Saul's sons in the battle?
options: They surrendered to the Philistine king
They survived and gathered the army again
They fled and escaped across the Jordan

questions.question: The men of Jabesh-gilead retrieved the bodies of Saul and his sons.
Saul fell on his own _____ rather than be captured by the Philistines.
Saul's son _____ was killed alongside him in the battle.
